title: gh-aw / SLO Overview
description: Glance: is the agentic-workflow fleet meeting expectations right now, and which happiness factor is not? Click a factor to scan which workflows violate it.

panels.title: Telemetry health (A4): data may be understated when red
panels.description:
Question: Can the numbers below be trusted? A4 is a trust gate for every other tile.
Metrics: Tier A: emitted by gh-aw.
SLI: A4.
Ignores variables: all variables (not workflow-scoped).

result.text: OTLP export failing: other tiles may be understated

panels.title: Availability: workflows run when triggered and are not stuck or dead
panels.description:
Question: Worst SLI state for Availability (SLO met, at risk or breached). Click to scan which workflows violate it.
Metrics: Tier A: emitted by gh-aw.
SLI: A1, A2, A3, A4.
Ignores variables: workflow, job, model (fleet level).

targets.expr: max(label_replace(2 * (((round(sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count[6h])))) or vector(0)) < bool 1), "sli", "A1", "", "") or label_replace(((((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{cicd_pipeline_task_run_result="timed_out"}[$slo_window]))) / ((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{cicd_pipeline_task_run_result!="cancelled"}[$slo_window]))) > 0)) or (((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{cicd_pipeline_task_run_result!="cancelled"}[$slo_window]))) > 0) * 0)) > bool 0.02) + ((((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{cicd_pipeline_task_run_result="timed_out"}[$slo_window]))) / ((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{cicd_pipeline_task_run_result!="cancelled"}[$slo_window]))) > 0)) or (((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{cicd_pipeline_task_run_result!="cancelled"}[$slo_window]))) > 0) * 0)) > bool 0.04), "sli", "A2", "", "") or label_replace(2 * (((round(sum(increase(gh_aw_otlp_export_failures_total[1h])))) or vector(0)) > bool 0), "sli", "A4", "", ""))

targets.expr: max(label_replace(((((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{gh_aw_job_name="agent",cicd_pipeline_task_run_result="success"}[1d]))) / ((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{gh_aw_job_name="agent",cicd_pipeline_task_run_result="success"}[7d])) / 7) > 0)) or (((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{gh_aw_job_name="agent",cicd_pipeline_task_run_result="success"}[7d])) / 7) > 0) * 0)) < bool 0.6) + ((((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{gh_aw_job_name="agent",cicd_pipeline_task_run_result="success"}[1d]))) / ((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{gh_aw_job_name="agent",cicd_pipeline_task_run_result="success"}[7d])) / 7) > 0)) or (((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{gh_aw_job_name="agent",cicd_pipeline_task_run_result="success"}[7d])) / 7) > 0) * 0)) < bool 0.4), "sli", "T1", "", "") or label_replace(((((sum(increase(gh_aw_workflow_output_items_total{gh_aw_safe_output_type!="noop"}[$slo_window]))) / ((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{gh_aw_job_name="agent"}[$slo_window]))) > 0)) or (((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{gh_aw_job_name="agent"}[$slo_window]))) > 0) * 0)) < bool 0.5) + ((((sum(increase(gh_aw_workflow_output_items_total{gh_aw_safe_output_type!="noop"}[$slo_window]))) / ((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{gh_aw_job_name="agent"}[$slo_window]))) > 0)) or (((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{gh_aw_job_name="agent"}[$slo_window]))) > 0) * 0)) < bool 0.3), "sli", "T2", "", ""))

targets.expr: max(label_replace(((((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{cicd_pipeline_task_run_result="success"}[$slo_window]))) / ((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{cicd_pipeline_task_run_result!="cancelled"}[$slo_window]))) > 0)) or (((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{cicd_pipeline_task_run_result!="cancelled"}[$slo_window]))) > 0) * 0)) < bool 0.95) + ((((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{cicd_pipeline_task_run_result="success"}[$slo_window]))) / ((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{cicd_pipeline_task_run_result!="cancelled"}[$slo_window]))) > 0)) or (((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{cicd_pipeline_task_run_result!="cancelled"}[$slo_window]))) > 0) * 0)) < bool 0.9), "sli", "Q1", "", "") or label_replace(((((sum(increase(gh_aw_tool_calls_total{gh_aw_tool_status="ok"}[$slo_window]))) / ((sum(increase(gh_aw_tool_calls_total[$slo_window]))) > 0)) or (((sum(increase(gh_aw_tool_calls_total[$slo_window]))) > 0) * 0)) < bool 0.9) + ((((sum(increase(gh_aw_tool_calls_total{gh_aw_tool_status="ok"}[$slo_window]))) / ((sum(increase(gh_aw_tool_calls_total[$slo_window]))) > 0)) or (((sum(increase(gh_aw_tool_calls_total[$slo_window]))) > 0) * 0)) < bool 0.8), "sli", "Q2", "", "") or label_replace(((((sum(increase(gh_aw_workflow_output_items_total{gh_aw_safe_output_type="report_incomplete"}[$slo_window]))) / ((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{gh_aw_job_name="agent"}[$slo_window]))) > 0)) or (((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{gh_aw_job_name="agent"}[$slo_window]))) > 0) * 0)) > bool 0.05) + ((((sum(increase(gh_aw_workflow_output_items_total{gh_aw_safe_output_type="report_incomplete"}[$slo_window]))) / ((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{gh_aw_job_name="agent"}[$slo_window]))) > 0)) or (((sum(increase(gh_aw_job_duration_seconds_count{gh_aw_job_name="agent"}[$slo_window]))) > 0) * 0)) > bool 0.1), "sli", "Q3", "", ""))

targets.expr: max(label_replace(((((((sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_input_tokens_total[7d])) + sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_output_tokens_total[7d])))) / ((sum(increase(gh_aw_workflow_output_items_total{gh_aw_safe_output_type!="noop"}[7d]))) > 0)) or (((sum(increase(gh_aw_workflow_output_items_total{gh_aw_safe_output_type!="noop"}[7d]))) > 0) * 0)) / (((((sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_input_tokens_total[28d])) + sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_output_tokens_total[28d])))) / ((sum(increase(gh_aw_workflow_output_items_total{gh_aw_safe_output_type!="noop"}[28d]))) > 0)) or (((sum(increase(gh_aw_workflow_output_items_total{gh_aw_safe_output_type!="noop"}[28d]))) > 0) * 0)) > 0)) > bool 1.5) + ((((((sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_input_tokens_total[7d])) + sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_output_tokens_total[7d])))) / ((sum(increase(gh_aw_workflow_output_items_total{gh_aw_safe_output_type!="noop"}[7d]))) > 0)) or (((sum(increase(gh_aw_workflow_output_items_total{gh_aw_safe_output_type!="noop"}[7d]))) > 0) * 0)) / (((((sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_input_tokens_total[28d])) + sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_output_tokens_total[28d])))) / ((sum(increase(gh_aw_workflow_output_items_total{gh_aw_safe_output_type!="noop"}[28d]))) > 0)) or (((sum(increase(gh_aw_workflow_output_items_total{gh_aw_safe_output_type!="noop"}[28d]))) > 0) * 0)) > 0)) > bool 2), "sli", "C1", "", "") or label_replace((((((sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_input_tokens_total[1d])) + sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_output_tokens_total[1d])))) / (((sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_input_tokens_total[7d])) + sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_output_tokens_total[7d]))) / 7) > 0)) or ((((sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_input_tokens_total[7d])) + sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_output_tokens_total[7d]))) / 7) > 0) * 0)) > bool 2) + (((((sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_input_tokens_total[1d])) + sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_output_tokens_total[1d])))) / (((sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_input_tokens_total[7d])) + sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_output_tokens_total[7d]))) / 7) > 0)) or ((((sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_input_tokens_total[7d])) + sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_output_tokens_total[7d]))) / 7) > 0) * 0)) > bool 3), "sli", "C2", "", "") or label_replace(((((sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_cache_read_input_tokens_total[$slo_window]))) / ((sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_input_tokens_total[$slo_window]))) > 0)) or (((sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_input_tokens_total[$slo_window]))) > 0) * 0)) < bool 0.4) + ((((sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_cache_read_input_tokens_total[$slo_window]))) / ((sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_input_tokens_total[$slo_window]))) > 0)) or (((sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_input_tokens_total[$slo_window]))) > 0) * 0)) < bool 0.2), "sli", "C3", "", "") or label_replace(2 * (((round((sum(increase(gh_aw_ai_credits_limit_exceeded_total[$slo_window]))) or vector(0) + (sum(increase(gh_aw_ai_credits_rate_limit_errors_total[$slo_window]))) or vector(0))) or vector(0)) > bool 0), "sli", "C4", "", ""))
